preconditions.expression: q == int(stdin.split()[0]) and q >= 1 and q <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 10³) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(a) <= (2**25 - 1) for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the q subsequent lines contains an integer a_i (2 ≤ a_i ≤ 2²⁵ - 1), one per line.
The input contains exactly q + 1 lines (1 for q and q for the a_i values).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(max(gcd((int(a) ^ b), (int(a) & b))) for a in [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]] for b in range(1, int(a)))) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each integer a_i in the input, the output is a line containing the maximum value of gcd(a_i XOR b, a_i AND b) for all integers b in the range 1 ≤ b < a_i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= int(a) for line, a in zip(stdout.split(), [int(x) for x in stdin.split()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a positive integer ≤ the corresponding input a_i, representing the maximum GCD achievable for that a_i.
